subject.title: test: keep local full-suite RAM within the host budget

question: Should the maintainer-owned scheduler fix change the automatic roomy-host full-suite default from nested `10x2` concurrency to a global-budget profile now?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the issue has a protected `maintainer` label and is assigned, so ClawSweeper should not queue or close it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Patch the automatic profile
options.body: Change the default local full-suite profile to spend the inferred worker budget once across shards while preserving explicit overrides and CI serialization.

options.title: Wait for aggregate RSS proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until the fixing PR includes the promised Testbox memory sample before accepting the default change.

options.title: Keep the aggressive default
options.body: Retain `10x2` for roomy hosts and document lower-concurrency overrides if maintainers decide speed is worth the memory pressure.

recommendation.title: Patch the automatic profile
recommendation.body: Change the default local full-suite profile to spend the inferred worker budget once across shards while preserving explicit overrides and CI serialization.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to steipete and recent adjacent full-suite inventory work was landed from that account.
